name: iris-compose-media
title_zh: 一条流水线串起图像、视频、语音的媒体编排器
tagline_zh: 图片生成后要审、视频摘要要转旁白、图像音频要合成视频——不用你手动搬中间产物，它替你编排每一步。
tagline_en: Generate-then-review, video-summary-to-narration, image+audio-to-video—no manual handoffs, it orchestrates the.
desc_en: Compose two or more dsh-iris tools into goal-driven image, video, speech, transcription, and multimodal workflows. Use when a request requires analyzing supplied media and creating a derivative, generating then reviewing an image, turning a video summary into narration, preparing image and audio inputs for video, or coordinating asynchronous Iris tasks. Do not use for a single direct media operati
why_zh: 不是单步工具，是任务编排层：能协调异步 Iris 任务，把分析、生成、转录串成有目标的多模态流程。
why_en: Not a single-step tool—an orchestration layer that coordinates async Iris tasks into goal-driven multimodal pipelines.
limit_zh: 只编排 dsh-iris 生态内的工具；单步直接媒体操作（如只转码）不该用它。需要你已装好 Iris 工具集。
limit_en: Only orchestrates dsh-iris tools; not for single direct media ops. Requires Iris toolset installed; I/O must follow Iris conventions.
title_en: A media orchestrator chaining image, video & speech tools
